definition.stop: first step after the last command faster than 0.02 m/s; censored if the chunk never gets there
definition.lead: integral of predicted minus expert forward speed over the executed steps of the chunk that is open at the stop
definition.tail: the same integral on executed steps at or after the true stop
definition.flat: median stop error at 1 s minus the error at 0.25 s is within 0.05 s, or within a quarter of the 0.25 s error
